name: "Enchanted Forest" Vanilla Cupcakes with Chocolate Frosting

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Duncan Hines classic yellow cake mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
TO MAKE THE CUPCAKES: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two 12-cup muffin pans with paper liners and set aside. (Or bake in batches if necessary.)
Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (432 g) box yellow cake mix
⅓ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Fill the muffin liners half-full with batter (about ¼-cup each). Place in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 19-23 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.
TO DECORATE THE CUPCAKES: Use a butter knife to spread the frosting over the top of each cupcake in an even layer.

Place coconut and food coloring in a small bowl. Using a spoon, mix well to combine and distribute the color evenly. (Add more food coloring, if necessary, to reach desired color.) Sprinkle a teaspoon of coconut "moss" onto each cupcake.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup shredded unsweetened coconut
10 drop green food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry raspberries. Gently stuff a marshmallow into the base of each raspberry to create "mushrooms." Nestle mushrooms into the icing, then add gummy worms.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (170 g) pkg raspberries
½ cup mini marshmallows
1 (227 g) pkg gummy worms

instructions.primary_message: Arrange decorated cupcakes on a platter and enjoy! If planning ahead, refrigerate the cupcakes and let them sit out at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before serving.
